criteria.description: Roadmap, dialect, and test-import docs reflect completed MVP work and the remaining syntax scope.
criteria.evidence: docs/project-plan.md, docs/sql-dialect.md, docs/test-import-strategy.md, docs/reference-corpus-snapshot.md, and docs/acceptance-syntax-completion.md were updated; zig build test passed.
criteria.notes: Documentation no longer presents the completed MVP kernel as merely planned.

criteria.description: MTR-lite executes accepted adapted fixtures and reports unsupported directives.
criteria.evidence: src/mariadb/mtr_lite.zig, src/cli/commands.zig run-adapted-test, tests/adapted_fixture_acceptance.zig, and all tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/*.md passed through run-adapted-test.
criteria.notes: Unsupported harness directives return UnsupportedDirective rather than being skipped.

criteria.description: SQL function-call expressions execute in projection, predicate, assignment-safe, and ordering contexts.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed executor and integration coverage; CLI parse/execute smokes in docs/acceptance-syntax-completion.md exercise function calls in SELECT and ORDER BY.
criteria.notes: Function calls are executed through the embedded SQL engine.

criteria.description: Vector SQL functions l2_distance, squared_l2_distance, and cosine_distance execute over vectors and literals.
criteria.evidence: tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/vector-distance-functions.md executed with 9 statements and 0 expected errors; zig build test passed vector distance integration coverage.
criteria.notes: Dimension and invalid-operand diagnostics remain typed.

criteria.description: Accepted scalar function needs are supported or unsupported functions are rejected explicitly.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed parser/executor coverage for accepted function calls and unsupported function diagnostics.
criteria.notes: No accepted adapted fixture requires additional scalar functions in this slice.

criteria.description: Projection aliases with AS and unambiguous MySQL-style implicit aliases are supported.
criteria.evidence: src/sql/parser.zig parser tests, tests/integration/query_source_acceptance.zig, and tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/query-syntax.md all passed.
criteria.notes: Ambiguous implicit aliases remain rejected.

criteria.description: Table aliases and qualified identifiers execute in query expressions.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/query_source_acceptance.zig and query-syntax adapted fixture passed qualified identifier and alias cases.
criteria.notes: Ambiguous unqualified columns produce typed diagnostics.

criteria.description: FROM sources are represented as AST row-source nodes for tables, views, derived tables, joins, and CTE refs.
criteria.evidence: src/sql/ast.zig and src/sql/parser.zig tests passed; tests/integration/query_source_acceptance.zig covers CTEs, derived tables, joins, and view wrapping.
criteria.notes: Single-table SELECT is no longer the only represented source shape.

criteria.description: INNER JOIN, plain JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and LEFT JOIN execute with ON predicates.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/query_source_acceptance.zig passed join cases; benchmark smoke reported joined_filter metric.
criteria.notes: LEFT JOIN unmatched rows are represented with NULL values.

criteria.description: Derived tables and non-recursive CTEs execute.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/query_source_acceptance.zig passed derived-table and chained non-recursive CTE cases; query-syntax fixture executed.
criteria.notes: Recursive CTEs remain outside this mission.

criteria.description: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX execute with GROUP BY and HAVING.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/aggregate_acceptance.zig and tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/grouping-aggregates.md passed; benchmark smoke reported grouped_scan.
criteria.notes: Invalid grouped projection returns InvalidGrouping.

criteria.description: Views can wrap richer supported SELECT forms.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/query_source_acceptance.zig view wrapping case passed; tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/query-syntax.md and view-basic.md executed.
criteria.notes: Views are not limited to simple SELECT * delegation.

criteria.description: Practical MySQL DDL modifiers and ordinary index metadata are accepted.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/ddl_acceptance.zig passed; src/db/catalog.zig, src/db/ddl.zig, src/db/persistence.zig, and parser/executor tests passed.
criteria.notes: Index metadata is catalog-visible but not optimizer-active.

criteria.description: Stored procedures support parameters, local variables, DECLARE, SET, multi-statement bodies, IF, and bounded WHILE.
criteria.evidence: tests/integration/procedure_acceptance.zig and tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/procedure-control-flow.md passed.
criteria.notes: Procedure execution uses caller transaction state.

criteria.description: Unsupported stored-program features are classified and rejected explicitly.
criteria.evidence: procedure-control-flow fixture executed two expected UnsupportedProcedure cases; zig build test passed cursor and dynamic SQL rejection coverage.
criteria.notes: Cursors, dynamic SQL, recursion, handlers, and OUT/INOUT remain rejected or deferred.

criteria.description: Integration tests cover SQL examples from the spec.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed all integration suites: kernel, query source, aggregate, DDL, procedure, and adapted fixture acceptance.
criteria.notes: Examples from vector ranking, query shapes, grouping, and procedures are covered.

criteria.description: Adapted MariaDB fixture descriptors exist for newly supported syntax and the reference corpus snapshot is refreshed.
criteria.evidence: docs/reference-corpus-snapshot.md, docs/reference-corpus-syntax-refresh.md, and all tests/fixtures/mariadb-adapted/*.md were validated by run-adapted-test.
criteria.notes: Full corpus classification remains 97 files, 2 sacred, 35 adaptation, 60 policy rejected.

criteria.description: Deliberate non-goal policy rejections are preserved.
criteria.evidence: Full corpus classify passed with 60 rejected-by-policy files; parser policy tests and docs/acceptance-syntax-completion.md list non-goals.
criteria.notes: Foreign keys, temp tables, storage engines, auth/admin SQL, replication, plugins, and ANN/vector indexes are not silently accepted.

criteria.description: Benchmark coverage includes vector ranking and joined or grouped scans.
criteria.evidence: zig build run -- benchmark --rows 20 --vectors 8 --dimensions 3 --operations 5 passed and reported grouped_scan, joined_filter, exact_vector_scan, and sql_vector_rank.
criteria.notes: WP09 added SQL-level vector ranking and join metrics.

criteria.description: Spec Kitty system notes are updated with repeated or new tooling anomalies.
criteria.evidence: docs/spec-kitty-system-notes.md records protected-main auto-commit issues, stale lane creation, review allocation failures, force-done lane recognition, and acceptance branch/matrix cleanup behavior.
criteria.notes: No unrecorded Spec Kitty blocker remains from this mission.
